intro:
Imagine a game where you get to kick a ball around, dodging obstacles and using an arsenal of weapons to take down anything that gets in your way. Welcome to 'Kick the ball and shoot', a sports browser game by GamePix that's equal parts challenging and addictive. This game checks all the boxes for a great time, with simple controls, colorful visuals, and enough power-ups to keep you coming back for more.

You'll be controlling a player who's trying to score goals by kicking a ball into the opponent's net. Sounds simple, right? But there's a catch - you'll have to navigate through a field filled with obstacles, from rocks and bottles to fire extinguishers and tires. And if that's not enough, you'll also have to contend with spears and other projectiles that are trying to take you down.

But here's the best part: you can use a variety of weapons to take out these obstacles and give yourself an edge. From pistols and machine guns to shotguns and grenade launchers, you'll have a whole arsenal at your disposal. And if you're feeling really lucky, you can even try out a shield to protect yourself from harm.

The game is easy to learn but hard to master, making it perfect for players of all ages and skill levels. And with achievements to unlock and a wide variety of power-ups to collect, you'll be hooked from the very start. So what are you waiting for? Let's dive in and see what 'Kick the ball and shoot' has to offer.
